question:
On basis of the passage, fill in the blanks in the following sentence.

The plate boundaries are made up of many ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "**faults.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We are required to select an option that states the component that makes the plate boundaries.
 
• Now, refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 2 and 3 of the paragraph 3: **The plate boundaries are made up of many faults**, and most of the earthquakes around the world occur on these faults. 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the correct word to fill in the blank is "faults."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
